text:
The plate is about 390 px across in the image. If it is a 26 cm dinner plate, that gives roughly 15 px per cm.

The potato pieces cover about 130 × 110 px, which is roughly 9 × 7 cm. Allowing for gaps and rounded edges, the footprint is about 45 cm². The pile is around 2.5 cm high, so the volume is about 60–70 cm³. Because the pieces are chunky and leave air between them, I estimate about 90 g of potatoes.

The ketchup-style sauce is spread over and beside the potatoes. It makes up roughly 25 g.
